items.source: Consider the default Component annotation that is meta-annotated with this annotation. If a component is annotated with Component, an entry for that component will be added to the index using the org.springframework.stereotype.Component stereotype.
items.translation: 考虑带有此注解的元注解的默认 Component 注解。如果组件使用 Component 进行注解，则使用该 org.springframework.stereotype.Component 立体类型向索引添加该组件的条目。

items.source: The CandidateComponentsIndex is an alternative to classpath scanning that uses a metadata file generated at compilation time. The index allows retrieving the candidate components (i.e. fully qualified name) based on a stereotype. This annotation instructs the generator to index the element on which the annotated element is present or if it implements or extends from the annotated element. The stereotype is the fully qualified name of the annotated element.
items.translation: `CandidateComponentsIndex` 是在编译时生成元数据文件以替代类路径扫描的另一种方案。该索引允许根据立体角色（stereotype）检索候选组件（即完全限定名）。此注解指示生成器对存在该注解的元素、或实现/继承自该注解的元素进行索引。立体角色即为被注解元素的完全限定名。
